Swap 也就是虚拟内存，当物理内存 (RAM) 不足时，Linux 系统会自动: Swap is virtual memory. When the physical memory (RAM) is insufficient, the Linux system will automatically temporarily swap some idle memory data to the dedicated Swap space on the disk to ensure stable operation of the system. Configuring Swap can greatly prevent key services (such as MySQL, Nginx, etc.) from being forcibly killed by the system due to memory overflow (OOM).
